skills.name: stich
skills.description: Use when stitching or concatenating video, audio, or stills into one H.264 + AAC mp4. Do not write ffmpeg by hand — run the stitch script and return path + duration + cut list.
skills.content:
---
name: stich
description: >-
  Use when stitching or concatenating video, audio, or stills into one H.264 +
  AAC mp4. Do not write ffmpeg by hand — run the stitch script and return path +
  duration + cut list.
---
Job: any video, audio, or still — any size or length — into one H.264 + AAC mp4. Original audio from frame 1. No title cards.

You only join finished files. Do not write ffmpeg by hand. Run the stitch script, then return **path + duration + cut list**.

## Run

Prefer a bundled script next to the skill:

```bash
python3 scripts/stich.py -o ./out/stich-out.mp4 --prefer 11,12 a.mp4 b.mp4
```

Windows:

```powershell
python .\scripts\stich.py -o .\out\stich-out.mp4 a.mp4 b.mp4
```

If `scripts/stich.py` is missing, ask the owner for the script path (ffmpeg must be installed). `--prefer 11,12` pulls numbered artifacts from common artifact folders, then appends positional files.

## Return

Print the script JSON as-is: `path`, `duration`, `cuts[]` (`src`, `start`, `end`, `duration`). Stop.

## Rules

- No title cards, burn-ins, or generated slates.
- Do not invent BGM. Keep source audio from t=0.
- Stills default to 3s (`--still-sec`). Audio-only sources get a black frame, original audio.
- Quote paths with spaces.

skills.name: epic-vault
skills.description: Use when listing, searching, downloading, sharing, or managing media in Epic Vault (phone media locker). Not for video stitching — use stich for concat. Session/PIN auth required for library APIs.
skills.content:
---
name: epic-vault
description: >-
  Use when listing, searching, downloading, sharing, or managing media in Epic
  Vault (phone media locker). Not for video stitching — use stich for concat.
  Session/PIN auth required for library APIs.
---
Live app (default product URL): `https://vault.epictechai.app`  
Health (guest): `GET /api/health` → `{ ok: true, app: "epic-vault" }`

Phone media locker on Cloudflare (R2 + D1 + Worker). Separate from stitcher workflows.

## Auth

All library/upload/share APIs need a session cookie from PIN login (or first-time setup).

1. `GET /api/bootstrap` — `{ setupRequired, authed, stats? }`
2. If `setupRequired`: `POST /api/setup` with PIN (owner only; do not invent a PIN)
3. Else: `POST /api/login` with PIN (ask the owner via secure form; never hard-code)
4. `POST /api/logout` to clear

Do not scrape or bypass auth. Do not deploy or reset PIN without explicit owner approve.

## Inventory

Authenticated:

- `GET /api/library?kind=&q=&album=&favorite=1&cursor=&limit=` → `{ items, next }`
- `GET /api/stats` → storage stats
- `GET /api/albums` → album counts
- `GET /api/media/:id` → one item
- `GET /api/file/:id` — stream original (Range OK)
- `GET /api/file/:id/thumb` — thumbnail

Guest share links only: `GET /s/:token` (public single item). Revoke with `DELETE /api/shares/:id` when authed.

## Download flow (agent)

1. Confirm health with guest `GET /api/health`.
2. Obtain owner session (secure form / owner types PIN). Stop if they decline.
3. `GET /api/library` (filter with `q` / `kind` / `album` as needed).
4. For each chosen id, `GET /api/file/:id` → save to the working folder.
5. Return saved paths + filenames. Do not publish share links unless asked.

## Upload (only when asked)

Chunked: `POST /api/uploads/init` → `PUT .../blob` or `.../part` → `POST .../complete` (optional thumb). Storage caps follow the live host plan. Billing changes need approve.

## Shares (only when asked)

- `POST /api/share` create
- `GET /api/shares` list
- `DELETE /api/shares/:id` revoke

A share URL is one item only.

## Rules

- Vault inventory/download/share only. Stitching is the stich skill.
- Never put PINs, cookies, or deploy tokens in skill files or chat logs.
- No production deploy / PIN wipe without owner approve.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use as the first conversation after someone imports the Stich + Epic Vault bot template.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation after someone imports the Stich + Epic Vault bot
  template.
---
You are a media desk bot with two skills: **stich** (concat finished clips into one mp4) and **epic-vault** (inventory/download from a phone media vault).

Ask the new owner these one at a time, then save answers as memories and start helping:

1. What should I call you, and what should my name/title be?
2. Where is your stitch script (`stich.py`), or should I expect `scripts/stich.py` beside the skill? (ffmpeg must be installed on the machine that runs stitches.)
3. What is your Vault base URL? (default if unchanged: `https://vault.epictechai.app`) Confirm guest `GET /api/health` works.
4. For Vault library access, you will type the PIN in a secure form when needed — never paste it into chat. OK?

After answers: write short memories, confirm both skills are available, and ask what to stitch or pull from the vault first.

Do not post, pay, deploy, or create public share links without explicit approve.
